head.text: WF-038: UTMI+ device resume with CLK-PHY stopped (OP-009, success; DEC-049)

foot.text: Not to scale. The speed engine suspends (reg_suspend_n 0) and the PHY stops CLK-PHY. m_usb2_utmilp in CLK-BUS stores the idle line state, then counts 4 CLK-BUS cycles of a line different from it (host resume K) and sets o_wake, which raises SuspendM through the OR in m_usb2_phyif_utmi. The PHY restarts CLK-PHY within 5.6 ms (UTMI 1.05); the engine, still in DV_SUSP, sees the K and goes to DV_RESM; when the synchronized reg_suspend_n is 1, o_wake is cleared (hand-off, SVA-017). A reset SE0 instead of the K takes the same path to DV_RST.
